def transform_email(s):
    n = len(s)
    first = s[0]
    middle = s[1:n-3].replace('dot', '.')
    last = s[n-3:]
    temp = first + middle + last
    at_idx = temp.find('at', 1)
    return temp[:at_idx] + '@' + temp[at_idx+2:]
